reason: Recovered SHoF primary schema defines market phases but does not label timestamp timezone. Validate the transformed clock using phase metadata, not a price/volume outcome. This replaces, rather than retroactively satisfies, the original demand for an explicit vendor timezone label.
phase_rule: Use documented opening cross/continuous phase transition and every continuous T row against dated Nasdaq regular-session schedule. Only candidate clocks are as-exported Europe/Stockholm and as-exported UTC converted to Europe/Stockholm. Compare opening transitions in both summer 2019 and winter 2023; retain phase anomaly counts. Local interpretation must uniquely conform. Last row near 17:25 alone is not evidence of phase transition.
reporting_label: local exchange clock inferred from documented phase metadata; not explicitly declared by SHoF
unchanged: last unambiguous positive uncrossed quote in final60sec strictly before documented continuous-session end
CLS_AUC required, no last trade or OFF_CLOSE fallback
quote_ties: If several distinct top-of-book quotes share final timestamp and order is not independently justified, block this stock-date; never select a preferred quote.
other_gates: Instrument, date, currency, price unit, auction field meaning and unique quote remain mandatory. Source amendment permits no arbitrary offset search or window change.
